question: Amrit Bharat Station Scheme launched in 2023 envisages taking up _____ stations for upgradation/modernisation of Indian Railways.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1309 stations**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1309 stations** are targeted for upgradation/modernisation under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme.
 
• The scheme was launched in **2023** by the Indian Railways to improve the infrastructure and facilities at these stations.
 
• It aims to enhance the overall passenger experience by providing modern amenities, better connectivity, and more efficient services.
 
• The upgradation includes **improvements in station buildings, platforms, waiting areas, and other passenger facilities**.
 
• The scheme is part of the broader initiative to modernize the Indian Railways and make it more **passenger-friendly and efficient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Railways** is one of the largest railway networks in the world, operating over 67,000 kilometers of track.
 
• The Amrit Bharat Station Scheme is part of the Indian government's efforts to **revitalize and modernize railway infrastructure** across the country.
 
• Stations selected under this scheme are strategically important for **passenger traffic and regional connectivity**.
 
• Modernization efforts include **energy-efficient lighting, digital signage, enhanced security measures, and eco-friendly initiatives**.
 
• The scheme is expected to significantly improve the **quality of travel** for millions of passengers who use Indian Railways daily.
